text:
Nina C.: Quick heads-up: I opened PR #4921 to add a short 'emergency rollback' appendix to the private/on-prem installer docs. Need a KMS failover example for air-gapped sites and an HSM sanity checklist.

Raj P.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921. Link-checker flagged a dead anchor in certs guide: '/docs/private/certs#verify' -> 404.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #4921 -> broken anchor /docs/private/certs#verify. Suggest /docs/private/certs#verify-chain.

Elena M.: For KMS fallback let's add two minimal examples: env var approach and explicit client config. Env example: `export RW_KMS=local && export RW_KMS_PATH=/var/lib/local-kms/keys` then `Client()` picks it up.

Raj P.: Client config snippet (Python): ```python
from rwinf_sdk import Client
c = Client(config={"kms":"local","kms_path":"/var/lib/local-kms/keys"})
``` Keep it small and call out non-prod testing.

Victor B.: HSM verification items to add: list slots `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`, check token label matches /etc/redwood/hsm.conf, then `pkcs11-tool --login --slot <id>` to verify PIN. Add note about permission of device nodes.

Nina C.: Rollback commands suggested: `rwinfctl rollback --to v2026.02 --force` and systemd safe-restart pattern: `sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference && tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/v2026.02.tgz -C /opt/redwood && sudo systemctl start redwood-inference`. Mention prefer SIGTERM/stop for graceful shutdown.

Elena M.: Also include cache flush blocker: `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:` — must run before service start to avoid stale metadata.

Victor B.: Add tiny KMS healthcheck one-liner: `curl --fail --connect-timeout 3 https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz || echo "local-kms unreachable"`. Note TLS cert pinning in air-gapped envs.

Raj P.: I'll fix the cert anchor to /docs/private/certs#verify-chain and add all snippets. I'll run the link-checker locally before pushing.

Docs Bot: automated-checks: please ensure snippets use backticks and that the docs lint warnings are addressed.

Nina C.: Thanks — ping here when CI green. Merge once link-checker is clean and Victor verifies PKCS#11 mapping in a staging VPC. :shipit:
